course_name_original: Foundations of Swedish for Working Life
course_name_en: Foundations of Swedish for Working Life
prerequisites: The Swedish entry level test, which can be found in MyCourses using the search terms "ruotsin lähtötasotesti + your own degree programme ARTS, BIZ, ENG, CHEM, ELEC or SCI" .
This course is intended for students who have received their school education in Finnish.
The student's level of proficiency is assessed prior to participation in the course.

learning_outcomes.text: you will be able to deal with the most common work-related communication situations both orally and in writing.
you can summarise, structure and present information about your own field of expertise in Swedish in a way that is easy to understand and appropriate to the context.
you can present and argue for your views in Swedish and understand Swedish-language, general texts also in your own specialised field.

syllabus_topics: oral and written communication situations in working life and everyday contexts
communicative ways of expressing yourself in different situations, and how to present and argue your points of view
general language and terminology in your own field of expertise
